evidence: Plaut. Amph. 88: ipse hanc āctūrust Juppiter cōmoediam
terms.comment: Of actors: fābulam agere, to perform a play; partēs agere, to play a part (Lewis & Short). Of music, canere or cantāre (see sing).

terms.gloss: perform to the end, play through
evidence: Cic. Sen. 70: neque enim histriōnī, ut placeat, peragenda fābula est

phrases.latin: neque enim histriōnī, ut placeat, peragenda fābula est, modo, in quōcumque fuerit āctū, probētur
phrases.english: An actor need not play the piece through to the end to please; it is enough that he wins approval in whatever act he appears.
Tomorrow the children are putting on a play.
